column1: # K2's bundled fonts for k2-deckrender: the ONLY fonts the renderer loads (never the system's).
# One row per file, tab-separated. Every file is the upstream file, byte for byte; tests/fonts.rs
# checks each against its sha256, and that its licence files sit beside it. Adding a family needs
#   compiled_in: deckcraft = compiled in by the vendored deckcraft-fonts (its last-resort family);
#                k2-deckrender = compiled in by this crate's build.rs from `file`.
#   file and licence_files: relative to crates/k2-deckrender (licence files: to the font's folder).
